patterns.note: Asymmetrical split-screen layout where the right column maintains a persistent, full-height dark background, acting as a continuous visual anchor across scroll depths.
Prominent use of a large, bold, modern sans-serif for primary headings, contrasted with a monospaced font for technical content and background animations.
High-contrast palette dominated by a warm off-white and a deep charcoal black, with minimal and subtle use of accent colors.
A continuous, full-height dark background on the right side of the viewport reveals a dynamic, code-like text animation as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections on the left side of the page are revealed by sliding up into view with a subtle fade as the user scrolls.

technique_notes: The primary layout utilizes a split-screen design where the right-hand column is a sticky or fixed element, spanning the full viewport height, while the left column scrolls independently.
Scroll-triggered animations are used to progressively reveal content sections on the left, making them slide up and fade in as they enter the viewport.

The dynamic, code-like text pattern on the persistent dark background is achieved using a canvas or Lottie animation, where characters or patterns are generated and revealed in response to scroll progress.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body size) with generous line height, complemented by standard body text and smaller, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to all interactive elements and content containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and spacious in hero and introductory sections, transitioning to a more balanced density within detailed content blocks.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the persistent, full-height split-screen layout where the right side continuously displays a dynamic, code-generating animation that responds to scroll, creating a unique visual anchor and a strong developer-centric aesthetic.
